scripts.check:csp: node -e "const fs=process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs');let bad=0;for(const f of ['apps/web/dist/index.html'])for(const m of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').match(/<script\\b[^>]*>/gi)||[])if(!/\\ssrc=/i.test(m)){bad++;console.error('INLINE <script> in '+f+': '+m)}if(bad){console.error('The deployed CSP is script-src self with no unsafe-inline, so those '+bad+' inline script(s) would be blocked and the app would render blank in production.');process.exit(1)}console.log('OK - no inline <script> in built HTML')"
